info.title: TradingAPI
info.description: Client-scoped HTTP API for Broker Apps to access account, asset, trading, and related business capabilities.

member_id.description: The `member_id` of the Client who holds the card.

card_type.description: Card/Coupon type: cash Cash card, quote Market data card, fundamental Fundamental card, commission Commission-free card, ipo IPO privilege card, ipo_interest IPO financing interest card, ipo_commission IPO fee card, stock Stock card, stock_fragment Fractional share card, platform_fee_deduct Platform fee deduction card, finance_interest Margin financing interest card, fund_interest Fund interest-boost card, coffee_coupon Coffee coupon

card_status.description:
Coupon/voucher status：

- `0` - Not activated
- `1` - Used
- `2` - Expired
- `3` - In use
- `4` - Activated

currency.description: Currency unit, applicable to Cash cards, Commission-free cards, IPO financing interest cards, IPO fee cards

invisible.description: Is invisible (used only in available-cards list scenario)

account_channel.description: Account channels applicable to the card/coupon

markets.description: Commission-free markets, e.g. US, SH, SG, HK

unlimited.description:
Commission-free mode：

- `0` - Proportional commission-free (collect first, rebate later; time-limited)
- `1` - Full commission-free (collect first, rebate later; time-limited)
- `2` - Lifetime commission-free (direct deduction; no usage limit)
- `6` - Fixed-amount per-use card (usage count limit, time-limited)
- `7` - Discount per-use card (usage count limit, time-limited)

commission_expired_time.description: Commission-free expiry time (for commission-free cards currently in use)

settlement_model.description: Settlement mode: payback charge-first-refund-later, compensate direct deduction

amount_limit.description: Per-use amount cap (unit: cents); absence means no limit

subscription_id.description: Reservation id; empty means generalized IPO card

financing_limit.description: Financing IPO quota threshold, 0 means no threshold

counter_id.description: Specified IPO stock id; empty means no restriction

amount.description: Number of shares issued, supports fractional shares

redemption_type.description: Redemption type: by_card_value redeem by card face value, shares_number fixed shares redemption (default)

counter_id.description: Applicable stock id; empty means fractional-share general card

fund_interest.description: Fund interest-boost card information (structure is dynamic JSON; fields are not fixed)

use_limit.description: Usage limit type: total total-use limit, period periodic-use limit

period_type.description: Period type (effective when use_limit is period), e.g. day

store_id_list.description: Store IDs where the coupon can be used.

is_available_all_store.description: Whether the coupon can be used at every store.

settled_store_id.description: ID of the store where the coupon was redeemed.

store_list.description: Stores where the coupon can be used. The item schema is not defined.

crypto.description: Virtual asset card information. The object schema is not defined.

receive_duration.description: Time for cash to arrive (seconds). Deprecated and pending removal; semantics same as cash.receive_duration; retained only for compatibility with legacy Broker App.

quote_duration.description: Permission duration (seconds). Deprecated and pending removal; semantics same as quote.quote_duration; retained only for compatibility with legacy Broker App.

markets.description: Commission-free markets. Deprecated and pending removal; semantics same as commission.markets; retained only for compatibility with legacy Broker App.

rebate_rate.description: Commission-free rebate rate. Deprecated and pending removal; semantics same as commission.rebate_rate; retained only for compatibility with legacy Broker App.

bz_types.description: Applicable underlying types. Deprecated and pending removal; semantics same as commission.bz_types; retained only for compatibility with legacy Broker App.

commission_balance.description: Commission-free card balance. Deprecated and pending removal; semantics same as commission.commission_balance; retained only for compatibility with legacy Broker App.

commission_duration.description: Commission-free card duration (seconds). Deprecated and pending removal; semantics same as commission.commission_duration; retained only for compatibility with legacy Broker App.

subscription_id.description: IPO privilege card subscription id. Deprecated and pending removal; semantics same as ipo.subscription_id; retained only for compatibility with legacy Broker App.

MemberRewardStatus.description:
Issuance status (applicable values vary slightly by reward type)：

- `12` - Issued
- `13` - Issuance failed
- `16` - Redeemed (coupon/voucher only)

TradeStatus.description:
Trading status：

- `0` - No market data (pending listing)
- `101` - Liquidation state
- `102` - Opening auction
- `105` - Trading
- `106` - Midday halt
- `107` - Closing auction
- `108` - Closed
- `110` - Dark pool awaiting open
- `111` - Dark pool trading
- `112` - Dark pool closed
- `120` - Fixed-price trade
- `121` - Half-day market closed
- `122` - Not opened
- `201` - US pre-market
- `202` - US trading
- `203` - US post-market
- `204` - US closed
- `205` - US halted
- `206` - US liquidation (including pre-market)
- `207` - US night session
- `1001` - Delisted
- `1002` - Preparing for listing
- `1003` - Code change
- `1004` - Suspended
- `1005` - Awaiting open
- `1006` - Trading paused for split/consolidation
- `1007` - Expired/not listed
- `1008` - No price
- `1009` - Not listed
- `1010` - Terminated trading
- `1011` - Waiting to list

get.summary: Get Aggregated Icons for Stock Detail Page
get.description: Retrieve aggregated badge icons displayed on a single stock's detail page (e.g., exchange, quote_level, financing, shorting, depth, fractional_shares, sh_sz_connect, etc.) for use as corner badges/icons on the detail page.

200.description: The request succeeded. The response body contains the result of the “Get aggregated icons for stock detail page” operation.

key.description: Identifier types: exchange exchange identifier, quote_level quote-level identifier, option night session identifier, option_extend option extended session identifier, cn_connect A-share connect identifier, financing financing identifier, shorting securities lending identifier, depth market depth identifier, fractional_shares fractional shares identifier, sh_sz_connect Shanghai-Shenzhen Stock Connect identifier

get.description: Retrieve risk-control parameters for a single stock such as financing and shorting margin ratios, used to determine whether the stock supports margin buy or short sell.

200.description: The request succeeded. The response body contains the result of the “Get stock margin ratio details” operation.

get.description: Query the financing margin ratios and financing rate information for a specified stock for displaying available financing amounts before placing an order.

200.description: The request succeeded. The response body contains the result of the “Get stock financing information” operation.

post.description: Client applies to adjust (increase) margin credit limit; submission immediately returns an adjustment result: adjustment successful, adjustment failed (exceeded adjustable maximum), or sent for manual review.

apply_amount.description: Requested adjustment amount; step size is 1000

adjust_status.description:
Adjustment status：

- `0` - Adjustment successful
- `1` - Adjustment failed (exceeded maximum adjustable amount)
- `2` - Under review

get.summary: Get Available/Unavailable Rebate Cards for an Order
get.description: Before placing a trading order, get the list of rebate/commission-free cards available and unavailable to the Client for the current instrument, so the Client can choose a card to use when placing the order.

parameters.name: counter_id
parameters.description: Underlying code, in the format type/market/code (for example, stock ST/HK/700, option OP/US/AAPL260722C205000)

parameters.name: bz_type
parameters.description:
Trading type:

- `0` - Stock trading
- `1` - Option trading

parameters.name: rebate_type
parameters.description:
Card type filter:

- `-1` - All
- `0` - Regular rebate card
- `1` - Unlimited rebate
- `2` - Lifetime commission-free card
- `3` - Cash card
- `4` - Platform fee card

parameters.name: order_amount
parameters.description: Order amount, used to verify whether the card meets the usage threshold

200.description: The request succeeded. The response body contains the result of the “Get Available/Unavailable Rebate Cards for an Order” operation.

get.description: Page through the Client's statement list (daily/monthly statements); returns each statement's display name and download key.

Statement type：

get.description: Retrieve the download URL, unlock password, and cache key for a statement (daily/monthly) PDF file for viewing and download.

get.description: Paginated query of the various coupons/cards a Client holds (cash cards, market-data cards, fundamental cards, commission-free cards, IPO privilege cards, stock cards, fractional-share cards, platform fee offset cards, financing interest cards, fund interest-boost cards, coffee vouchers, AI benefit cards, etc.), supporting filtering by status and card type.

parameters.name: card_status
parameters.description:
Coupon/voucher status filter：

- `-1` - Not expired

parameters.name: card_type
parameters.description: Card type filter; empty returns all. Aggregate tabs: ipo_tab (IPO benefit card aggregated), quote_tab (merged quote/fundamental cards); single card types: cash, quote, fundamental, commission, ipo, ipo_interest, ipo_commission, stock, stock_fragment, platform_fee_deduct, finance_interest, fund_interest, coffee_coupon

valid_card_types.description: Valid card types list (protobuf annotation: to be deprecated)

get.description: Paginated query of rewards a Client has received (cash rewards, physical rewards, coupon rewards, task-coin rewards), supporting filtering by reward type.

- `-1` - All
- `0` - Cash
- `1` - Physical item
- `2` - Coupon/voucher

get.summary: Get Underlying Stock Option Trading/Position Statistics (Daily)
get.description: Query daily aggregated statistics for all option contracts under an underlying stock—total volume, total open interest, put/call ratios, etc. Supports timestamp-based pagination into history; used for volume/open-interest trend charts on the options analytics page.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Timestamp; for the initial request pass the current time, for pagination pass (earliest loaded record's timestamp - 1)

parameters.name: line_num
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return in this request

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description:
Pagination direction：

- `0` - Page toward historical data
- `1` - Page toward latest data; default 0

200.description: The request succeeded. The response body contains the result of the “Get underlying stock option trading/position statistics (daily)” operation.

total_volume.description: Total volume of all options under the underlying

total_put_volume.description: Total volume of put options under the underlying

total_call_volume.description: Total volume of call options under the underlying

total_open_interest.description: Total open interest of all options under the underlying

total_put_open_interest.description: Total open interest of put options under the underlying

total_call_open_interest.description: Total open interest of call options under the underlying

get.summary: Get Option Chain Expiration Date List
get.description: Query the list of available expiration dates for an underlying's option chain and the strike price list for the default expiration; used to render the expiration-date tabs on the option chain page.

parameters.name: expire_date
parameters.description: Expiration date in format YYYYMMDD; if specified returns the strike list for that expiration, if omitted returns the data for the nearest expiration (i.e., default_expire_date)

parameters.name: standard_attr
parameters.description:
Standard attribute：

- `S` - Standard option
- `N` - Non-standard option (adjusted options generated after corporate actions such as stock splits/mergers; Broker App labels as Old; some multi-leg strategy orders and position adjustments may exclude N); used together with expire_date

200.description: The request succeeded. The response body contains the result of the “Get option chain expiration date list” operation.

strike_price.description: Strike list for the default (or specified) expiration date

get.summary: Get Option-Chain Strike List for a Specified Expiration
get.description: Query the strike list for an underlying's option chain by expiration; each strike includes the corresponding call/put contract codes. Used to display data after switching expiration on the option chain page.

parameters.name: standard_attr
parameters.description:

get.description: Get the filter configuration for the option strategy guide (the “Strategy Guide” feature on the option chain page). The response includes candidate lists across dimensions such as investment objective, available expiration dates, price trend, sort order, strategy type, and investment style, used to render the filter conditions on the guide page. Each candidate item's value is the value to pass to the corresponding parameter of POST /calc/op/guide/search.

description.description: Explanatory text for this investment objective

value.description:
Value:

- `1` - Buy Call
- `2` - Sell Put
- `3` - Sell Call
- `4` - Buy Put

default.description: Whether this is the default selected item

expectation.name: Trend Profit
expectation.description: A trading approach that involves buying a call or put option, aiming for a larger gain when the underlying stock price rises or falls sharply in the expected direction.

expectation.name: Steady Profit
expectation.description: A trading approach that involves selling a call or put option, earning premium income when the underlying stock price stays near the strike price or moves in a favorable direction.

strategy.name: Buy Call
strategy.introduction: Investors who expect the stock to rise sharply can choose the Buy Call strategy. Buying a call gives the investor the right to buy the stock at the strike price; if the stock price rises significantly, this can generate a larger gain.

strategy.name: Sell Put
strategy.introduction: Investors who expect the stock to rise can choose the Sell Put strategy. Selling the put earns premium income; if the stock stays above the strike price, this generates a steady gain, while if the stock falls below the strike price, the investor is obligated to buy the stock at the strike price.

strategy.name: Sell Call
strategy.introduction: Investors who expect the stock to fall can choose the Sell Call strategy. Selling the call earns premium income; if the stock stays below the strike price, this generates a steady gain, while if the stock price exceeds the strike price, the investor is obligated to buy the stock at the strike price.

strategy.name: Buy Put
strategy.introduction: Investors who expect the stock to rise can choose the Sell Put strategy. Selling the put earns premium income; if the stock stays above the strike price, this generates a steady gain, while if the stock falls below the strike price, the investor is obligated to buy the stock at the strike price.
